description: secrets: inherit does not carry across accounts at the second level of a chain: the callee of the same account may inherit, the callee it inherits to may not hand every secret on to another account
caller:
on: push
jobs:
  top:
    uses: GlobalArt/shared/.github/workflows/middle.yml@v1
    secrets: inherit

shared..github/workflows/middle.yml:
on: workflow_call
jobs:
  next:
    uses: ThirdParty/lib/.github/workflows/release.yml@v1
    secrets: inherit

foreign..github/workflows/release.yml:
on: workflow_call
jobs:
  first:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    steps:
      - run: make

expected.message: `secrets: inherit` is allowed only for a callee of the same account as the calling workflow; pass the secrets by name
